verdict.rationale: Microsoft's first-party docs have a dedicated Terraform-on-Azure section covering provisioning VMs and other infrastructure, exporting existing resources to HCL, and generating Terraform configs with Azure Copilot. This shows Terraform is an officially supported IaC path. One community comment complains that Microsoft won't update the required Terraform version, which suggests vendor control of the tooling but also friction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the provider itself is vendor-maintained, release cadence or activity, documented coverage across core services, OpenTofu compatibility, and independent hands-on corroboration.
